POST /api/projects/{project_id}/dataset_items/
Create an item and its first immutable version. An identical client item ID retry returns the existing item. A different payload or an archived match returns a conflict.

name: List a dataset's current items or its exact contents at a prior revision.
description: List a dataset's current items or its exact contents at a prior revision. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/dataset_items/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/dataset_items/
List a dataset's current items or its exact contents at a prior revision.
Required: dataset (query) — Dataset whose items should be returned.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: archived (query) — Return archived items instead of active items.; limit (query) — Number of results to return per page.; offset (query) — The initial index from which to return the results.; revision (query) — Return the exact dataset snapshot at this revision.
